svg.text: Resting membrane potential: ion gradients plus a K+ leak
Na+ 145 mM · K+ 5 mM · Cl− 110 mM
K+ 140 mM · Na+ 5-15 mM · Cl− 5-15 mM
V_m = φ_in − φ_out ≈ −70 mV in a neuron: a thin layer of + outside and − inside the membrane.
The bulk stays neutral: about 1 K+ in 60,000 leaves to charge a cell 20 µm across (see Deeper).
